讓模組在訊號變化時「主動回報」品質數據，不必狂按 AT+CSQ。SQI 給的 R: Makes the module report quality data on its own whenever the signal changes, so you do not have to hammer AT+CSQ. PDP context＝電信網路配給的「資料通道」，有它才有 IP 可用。這組是: A PDP context is the "data channel" the carrier allocates; without one there is no usable IP. This group is read-only queries at the 3GPP standard layer, which is NOT the same layer as QIACT? / QICSGP on the TCP/IP page — those belong to Quectel's own protocol stack. The two layers can disagree, and comparing them side by side tells you whether the fault is on the network side or the module side: an IP here but none on the TCP/IP page means the network granted one but the stack never started. This unit activates context 1 and gets an IP automatically at power-on (measured), so manual intervention is normally unnecessary.

查 SIM 卡是否插著（第一欄是 URC 開關不是卡狀態）: Query whether the SIM is inserted (the first field is the URC switch, not the card state)
查 PS 封包域是否已附著網路: Query whether the PS packet domain is attached to the network
列出已定義的 PDP context（每個一行）: List the defined PDP contexts (one per line)
查各 PDP context 的啟用狀態（每個一行）: Query each PDP context's activation state (one per line)
列出各 context 實際取得的 IP（3GPP 層，與 QIACT? 不同層: List the IP each context actually obtained (3GPP layer, a different layer from QIACT?)
查累計收發位元組（跨開機累計，需曾存檔）: Query the cumulative bytes sent and received (accumulates across reboots; it must have been saved before)
查網路同步的時間（與 AT+CCLK? 的 RTC 不同來源）: Query the network-synced time (a different source from the RTC read by AT+CCLK?)
從未成功做過網路時間同步（未附著或電信商未下發）: Network time sync has never succeeded (not attached, or the carrier never sent it)
查是否允許模組進入睡眠: Query whether the module is allowed to enter sleep
以預設參數掃描 2.4G 熱點（結果在 OK 之後非同步回報）: Scan 2.4G access points with the default parameters (results are reported asynchronously after OK)
自訂參數掃描 2.4G 熱點（結果在 OK 之後非同步回報）: Scan 2.4G access points with custom parameters (results are reported asynchronously after OK)
開啟複誦：模組複誦所收字元: Enable echo: the module echoes the characters it receives
關閉複誦：模組不再複誦字元: Disable echo: the module no longer echoes characters
設定 client 0 用 MQTT v3.1.1（vsn=4），須在連線建立前: Set client 0 to MQTT v3.1.1 (vsn=4); it must be issued before the connection is established, and it is not saved
Set client 0's keep-alive to 120 s, the default value; no traffic for more than 1.5 times that gets you disconnected
為 client 0 開 1883 埠的 MQTT 網路，但主機位址是空字串，手: Open an MQTT network on port 1883 for client 0, but with an empty string as the host address — the manual does not describe the behavior of an empty value
查詢已開啟的 MQTT 網路，回報 client 編號、主機位址與埠號，未開只回: Query the MQTT network that is open; it reports the client number, host address and port, or just OK if none is open
以卡片填入的 client ID 登入伺服器，未帶帳密，須先 QMTOPEN 開: Log in to the server with the client ID from the card, without credentials; QMTOPEN must have opened the network first
查詢 MQTT 連線狀態，state 1＝初始化、2＝連線中、3＝已連線、4＝斷: Query the MQTT connection state: state 1=initializing, 2=connecting, 3=connected, 4=disconnecting
client 0 用 msgid 1 訂閱指定 topic，QoS 0＝最多送一: Client 0 subscribes to the given topic with msgid 1, QoS 0 = at most once
發佈 17 bytes 到該 topic（QoS 0、不保留）；兩段式：等 >: Publish 17 bytes to that topic (QoS 0, not retained); two-stage: wait for > then send the payload. Up to 15 s, at most 5 unacknowledged messages
client 0 用 msgid 2 退訂指定 topic，結果由 +QMTUN: Client 0 unsubscribes from the given topic with msgid 2; the result is reported by +QMTUNS
通知伺服器 client 0 中斷 MQTT 連線，+QMTSTAT 回 5 屬: Tell the server that client 0 is closing the MQTT connection; +QMTSTAT returning 5 is part of the normal flow
關閉 client 0 的 MQTT 網路（TCP 層），結果由 +QMTCLO: Close client 0's MQTT network (the TCP layer); the result is reported by +QMTCLOSE
測試指令，列出 sslversion、seclevel、cacert 等全部設定: Test command that lists every configuration sub-item and parameter range — sslversion, seclevel, cacert and the rest; a pure query that changes nothing.
把 SSL context 1 的協定版本設為 4＝全部版本（0～3 為 SSL: Set SSL context 1's protocol version to 4 = all versions (0 to 3 are SSL3.0/TLS1.0/1.1/1.2); it takes effect immediately but is not saved across reboots.
省略版本參數即為查詢，回讀 SSL context 1 目前的協定版本碼，不會改: Omitting the version parameter makes it a query, reading back SSL context 1's current protocol version code without changing any existing setting.
設定 SSL context 1 的加密套件為 0XFFFF＝支援全部套件；手冊: Set SSL context 1's cipher suite to 0XFFFF = all suites supported; the manual notes that the module supports them all by default anyway.
憑證驗證等級 0＝不驗證（本工具唯一走得完的）；1 需先上傳 CA、2 還要 c: Certificate authentication level 0 = no verification (the only one this tool can complete); 1 needs a CA uploaded first and 2 also needs a client certificate and private key. Not saved
省略數值即為查詢，回讀 SSL context 1 目前的認證模式：0 不認證、: Omitting the value makes it a query, reading back SSL context 1's current authentication mode: 0 none, 1 verify the server, 2 mutual.
省略路徑參數即為查詢，回讀 SSL context 1 已設定的信任 CA 憑證: Omitting the path parameter makes it a query, reading back the trusted CA certificate path set on SSL context 1; cacertex queries all of them.
把 SSL context 1 的信任 CA 憑證指向 UFS 內的 cacer: Point SSL context 1's trusted CA certificate at cacert.pem in UFS; this only registers the path, and the certificate file still has to be uploaded to the module separately.
開啟 SSL context 1 的 SNI（1＝啟用、0＝關閉），握手時帶出伺: Enable SNI on SSL context 1 (1=enabled, 0=disabled) so the server host name is carried in the handshake; the manual states it applies to TLS only.
1＝略過憑證有效期檢查（模組 RTC 不準時用）；設定不保存，重開機後失效、有效: 1 = skip the certificate validity check (for when the module's RTC is off); not saved, so after a reboot it lapses and the validity check comes back
TLS 交握最長等待 60 秒。設定不保存 —— 重開機回預設 300，QSSL: The TLS handshake waits at most 60 s. Not saved — after a reboot it returns to the default 300 and QSSLOPEN's wait limit goes back to 150 + 300 s
省略秒數即為查詢，回讀 SSL context 1 目前的握手逾時上限，單位秒，: Omitting the seconds makes it a query, reading back SSL context 1's current handshake timeout limit in seconds; the manual default is 300.
以 PDP 1、SSL context 1 建立到指定主機與埠的連線，clien: Open a connection to the given host and port over PDP 1 and SSL context 1 with clientID 4; the trailing 0 = buffer retrieval mode. It returns OK first, then the URC reports the result.
以 PDP 1、SSL context 1 連指定主機與埠，末碼 1＝直推模式，: Connect to the given host and port over PDP 1 and SSL context 1; the trailing 1 = direct push mode, where received data is emitted with its content by +QSSLURC and no QSSLRECV is needed.
執行式指令，一次列出所有 SSL 連線的狀態；狀態碼 0＝初始、1＝連線中、2＝: Execution command that lists the state of every SSL connection at once; status codes 0=initial, 1=connecting, 2=connected, 4=closing.
只查 clientID 4 這一條連線，回報遠端位址與埠、本地埠、狀態碼、PDP: Query only the clientID 4 connection; it reports the remote address and port, the local port, the status code, the PDP and SSL context IDs and the AT port in use.
對 clientID 4 送出固定長度 17 bytes：模組回 > 提示後須輸: Send a fixed 17 bytes to clientID 4: after the module's > prompt you must enter all 17 bytes before it sends; the per-call limit is 1460 and out-of-range values return ERROR.
從 clientID 4 的接收緩衝讀取最多 1500 bytes（範圍 0–1: Read up to 1500 bytes from clientID 4's receive buffer (range 0–1500, default 1500); this is how you fetch data in buffer retrieval mode.
關閉 clientID 4 的 SSL 連線，未帶逾時參數即採預設 10；同一: Close clientID 4's SSL connection; without a timeout parameter the default 10 applies. The module only releases the SSL context once every connection on it is closed.
關閉 clientID 4 並把 close_timeout 設為 0＝立即關閉: Close clientID 4 with close_timeout set to 0 = close immediately without waiting; range 0–65535, which saves the default 10 s wait.
列出 9 個設定子項：7 項回支援值範圍，reqheader/add 與 rem: Lists 9 configuration sub-items: 7 return supported value ranges, while reqheader/add and remove return only the parameter format (custom headers have no range to list)
讀取指令，一次列出 9 項 HTTP 設定的目前值；這些設定不保存，重開後回預設: Read command that lists the current values of all 9 HTTP settings at once; these settings are not saved and revert to defaults after a reboot.
把 HTTP 綁到 PDP context 1；範圍 1–15、預設 1，該 c: Bind HTTP to PDP context 1; range 1–15, default 1, and the context must be activated first.
回應標頭預設不輸出；設 1 後 QHTTPREAD／READFILE 會把 he: Response headers are not output by default; set 1 and QHTTPREAD/READFILE emit the header as well.
0＝不自訂請求標頭，交給模組自動填；此時 QHTTPPOST 只要輸入 body: 0 = no custom request header, leaving the module to fill it in; QHTTPPOST then only needs the body.
設 HTTP body 資料型別為 4＝application/json，手冊只: Set the HTTP body data type to 4 = application/json; the manual defines only the six values 0–5.
0＝關閉回應自動輸出，之後要自己下 QHTTPREAD 讀；設 1 反而會讓 R: 0 = disable automatic response output, so you issue QHTTPREAD yourself; setting 1 actually makes READ fail.
1＝開啟關閉指示，session 結束時模組會主動回報 +QHTTPURC: \: 1 = enable the close indication, so the module reports +QHTTPURC: "closed" when the session ends.
省略參數即查詢：列出目前已加的自訂請求標頭筆數與 name:value，不會新增: Omitting the parameters makes it a query: it lists how many custom request headers are set and their name:value pairs, adding nothing.
新增自訂請求標頭：名稱與內容皆為字串，由卡片填入。: Add a custom request header: both the name and the content are strings, taken from the card.
移除先前以同名加入的自訂標頭；此格式必帶名稱，不能省略參數。: Remove the custom header added earlier under the same name; this form requires the name and the parameter cannot be omitted.
指定 HTTPS 走 SSL context 1；範圍 0–5、預設 1，憑證等: Route HTTPS through SSL context 1; range 0–5, default 1. Certificates and the rest are set separately with AT+QSSLCFG.
查目前設定的 HTTP(S) 伺服器 URL；手冊把回應的 URL 標成方括號選: Query the currently configured HTTP(S) server URL; the manual marks the URL in the response as an optional field in square brackets.
兩段式設 URL：等 CONNECT 再送 23 bytes。有 GET/POS: Two-stage URL setting: wait for CONNECT, then send 23 bytes. No CONNECT is given while a GET/POST is in progress; if another port is holding data mode you get error 704
送出 GET 請求，80 秒為等 +QHTTPGET URC 的逾時（1–655: Send the GET request; the 80 s is the timeout for waiting on the +QHTTPGET URC (1–65535, default 60).
從位移 0 取 512 的分段 GET（手冊未標單位與範圍，需實測）；會實際連線: Ranged GET of 512 from offset 0 (the manual states neither unit nor range, so measure it yourself); it really connects and consumes traffic
讀回應本體，會進 data mode。中途 +++ 或拉 DTR 會中斷且無法用: Read the response body; it enters data mode. Sending +++ or pulling DTR midway aborts it and ATO cannot get you back; the real end is that last +QHTTPREAD line
兩段式 POST：等 CONNECT 後送 body。20＝長度，request: Two-stage POST: wait for CONNECT, then send the body. 20 = the length, which is header plus body when requestheader=1; CONNECT can take up to 125 s
用指定的 UFS 檔當 POST 內容送出，等回應逾時 80 秒；檔名上限 80: Send the given UFS file as the POST body, with an 80 s response timeout; the file name is limited to 80 bytes.
把伺服器回應存進指定的 UFS 檔，80 秒同樣是封包間的最大間隔，不是總逾時。: Save the server response into the given UFS file; the 80 s is again the maximum gap between packets, not a total timeout.
取消進行中的 GET／POST 請求並中斷與伺服器的連線，最長 10 秒內回應。: Cancel the GET/POST request in progress and drop the connection to the server; it answers within 10 s.
列出全部 FTP 設定子項：9 項回支援值範圍，account 那行會明文吐出目: Lists every FTP configuration sub-item: 9 return supported value ranges, and the account line prints the current username and password in clear text (mask it before pasting logs)
指定 FTP(S) 使用的 PDP 承載編號為 1；範圍 1–15、預設 1，手: Set the PDP bearer used by FTP(S) to 1; range 1–15, default 1. The manual requires activating that bearer with AT+QIACT before logging in.
查詢式寫法：省略設定值即回讀目前 FTP 使用的 PDP 承載編號，不會更動任何: Query form: omitting the value reads back the PDP bearer number FTP currently uses without changing anything.
設定登入帳密，前者帳號後者密碼，各上限 255 位元組；此設定不保存，重開機後要: Set the login credentials, username first and password second, each up to 255 bytes; this is not saved, so you must set it again after a reboot.
查詢目前設定的 FTP 帳號與密碼；手冊寫明回應會把密碼原樣印出來，畫面共享時要: Query the configured FTP username and password; the manual states that the response prints the password verbatim, so be careful when sharing your screen.
傳輸模式設 1＝被動模式，由伺服器開埠等客戶端連入；手冊規定 FTPS 只能用被: Set the transfer mode to 1 = passive, where the server opens a port for the client to dial into; the manual specifies that FTPS is passive-only and does not support active mode.
設定傳輸資料型態為 1＝ASCII，0 則為 Binary；手冊只說兩者擇一，未: Set the transfer data type to 1 = ASCII, with 0 for Binary; the manual only says to pick one and gives no conversion details.
回應逾時設 90 秒（範圍 20–180、預設 90）；它同時是資料模式下兩包資: Set the response timeout to 90 s (range 20–180, default 90); it is also the maximum gap between two data packets in data mode.
把 SSL 型態設為 0，代表模組當一般 FTP 客戶端不加密；1 為 FTPS: Set the SSL type to 0, meaning the module acts as a plain unencrypted FTP client; 1 is FTPS implicit encryption and 2 is explicit.
指定要用的 SSL 內容編號為 1（範圍 0–5、預設 0）；憑證與版本等細節要: Set the SSL context number to 1 (range 0–5, default 0); certificates, versions and other details are set separately with AT+QSSLCFG.
資料連線位址策略設 2＝優先用控制連線的位址，連不上再改用伺服器指派的位址。: Set the data connection address policy to 2 = prefer the control connection's address and fall back to the server-assigned one if it will not connect.
設定快取（手冊稱 WM）為 0＝預設模式 64 KB；1 為快速模式 128 K: Set the cache (called WM in the manual) to 0 = default mode, 64 KB; 1 is fast mode with 128 KB and 2 is slow mode with 128 KB and resumable downloads.
資料連線的關閉方式設為 0；手冊只寫 0＝Wavehand、1＝送 RST 封包: Set the data connection close method to 0; the manual only says 0 = Wavehand and 1 = send an RST packet, and lists no other behavior.
查詢 FTP(S) 連線狀態，回 0 開啟中、1 已開啟閒置、2 傳輸中、3 關: Query the FTP(S) connection state: 0 opening, 1 open and idle, 2 transferring, 3 closing, 4 closed.
連線並登入 FTP 伺服器的指定埠（預設 21）；OK 只表示收下指令，成功與否: Connect and log in to the FTP server on the given port (default 21); OK only means the command was accepted, and the +QFTPOPEN URC that follows decides success.
查詢目前在伺服器上的工作目錄，成功回 +QFTPPWD: 0,<路徑>；等待上限: Query the current working directory on the server; success returns +QFTPPWD: 0,<path>, with the wait capped by rsptimeout.
把工作目錄切到根目錄 /；之後所有檔案與目錄操作都以這個目錄為基準，路徑上限 1: Change the working directory to the root /; every later file and directory operation is relative to it, with paths limited to 128 bytes.
列出目前目錄（詳細格式），結果走 data mode。退出要 +++（前後各靜默: List the current directory (detailed format); the result goes through data mode. To get out, use +++ (1 s of silence before and after) or pull DTR (AT&D1 required first)
同樣列出目前目錄內容，但明寫輸出到 COM 埠；此參數在 LIST 的長度上限是: Also lists the current directory, but explicitly writes the output to the COM port; in LIST this parameter is limited to 60 bytes.
列出目前目錄的檔名；LIST 回完整內容，這條只回檔名，一樣預設輸出到 COM: List the file names in the current directory; LIST returns everything while this returns names only, and it likewise defaults to the COM port and enters data mode.
以標準化格式列出目前目錄的檔案與目錄資訊；預設送到 COM 埠，先回 CONNE: List the files and directories in the current directory in a standardized format; it defaults to the COM port and returns CONNECT before emitting data.
查伺服器上檔案的最後修改時間；逾時內沒收到 +QFTPMDTM URC 就要斷線: Query a file's last modification time on the server; if no +QFTPMDTM URC arrives before the timeout, disconnect and restart the PDP bearer
查詢伺服器上指定檔案的大小，單位位元組；逾時內若沒回應，手冊要求斷線並重新啟用網: Query the size of the given file on the server in bytes; if there is no reply before the timeout, the manual requires disconnecting and re-activating the network.
從第 0 位元組起下載指定檔案，只輸出 512 位元組到 COM 埠就退出資料模: Download the given file from byte 0, emitting only 512 bytes to the COM port before leaving data mode; continue the rest with the same command at a new start position.
不指定起點與長度，整個檔案直接由 COM 埠吐出；傳完模組會自動離開資料模式。: With no start position or length given, the whole file is emitted straight from the COM port; the module leaves data mode automatically when the transfer finishes.
查詢這次傳輸已完成的資料長度（位元組），適用於 PUT／GET／NLST／LIS: Query how much data this transfer has completed (in bytes); use it after PUT/GET/NLST/LIST.
跳出資料模式回到 AT 指令模式；前後各需靜默 1 秒，中間 1 秒內打完且不可: Escape data mode back to AT command mode; 1 s of silence before and after, all three typed within 1 s, with no other character mixed in.
讓連接埠重新進入先前的資料模式；手冊寫明只有 QFTPGET、QFTPLIST、: Put the port back into its previous data mode; the manual states that this only works after QFTPGET, QFTPLIST or QFTPNLST.
從第 0 位元組起上傳指定檔案，資料由 COM 埠輸入，本次 17 位元組，且: Upload the given file from byte 0 with the data coming in from the COM port; 17 bytes this time, and the 1 marks this as the last packet.
在伺服器建立資料夾；逾時內沒收到 +QFTPMKDIR URC，手冊要求斷 FT: Create a folder on the server; if no +QFTPMKDIR URC arrives before the timeout, the manual requires closing FTP and deactivating then re-activating the PDP
重新命名伺服器上的檔案或資料夾；逾時內沒收到 +QFTPRENAME URC 就: Rename a file or folder on the server; if no +QFTPRENAME URC arrives before the timeout, disconnect and restart the PDP
刪除伺服器上的指定檔案；OK 只表示指令收下，結果要看 +QFTPDEL 的錯誤: Delete the given file on the server; OK only means the command was accepted, and the result is in +QFTPDEL's error and protocol codes.
刪除伺服器上的資料夾；逾時內沒收到 +QFTPRMDIR URC，手冊要求斷 F: Delete a folder on the server; if no +QFTPRMDIR URC arrives before the timeout, the manual requires closing FTP and restarting the PDP bearer
登出並關閉目前這條 FTP(S) 連線；手冊說收到 +QFTPCLOSE URC: Log out and close the current FTP(S) connection; the manual says you can log in again from AT+QFTPOPEN once the +QFTPCLOSE URC arrives.
讀取式，列出目前已啟用的 PDP context 及其 IP 位址，未啟用者不出: Read command that lists the currently activated PDP contexts and their IP addresses; inactive ones do not appear
設定 context 1：IPv4、APN 由卡片填入、認證 1=PAP；設定不: Configure context 1: IPv4, the APN from the card, authentication 1=PAP; not saved
啟用 context 1 的 PDP，最長阻塞 150 秒，須先用 QICSGP: Activate the PDP of context 1; it blocks for up to 150 s, and QICSGP must have set the parameters first
停用 context 1 並關閉其下所有 TCP/IP 連線，最長阻塞 40 秒: Deactivate context 1 and close every TCP/IP connection on it; it blocks for up to 40 s
用 context 1 ping 指定目標，每次最多等 4 秒、共送 4 次請求: Ping the given target over context 1, waiting at most 4 s per try for 4 requests in total
用 context 1 查此網域 IP，結果由 dnsgip URC 回報，最長: Look up this domain's IP over context 1; the result is reported by the dnsgip URC, up to 60 s
向 NTP 伺服器對時，最長 125 秒。未帶第 4 參數即預設 1＝會覆寫模組: Sync the time with an NTP server, up to 125 s. Omitting the 4th parameter means the default 1, which overwrites the module's RTC; write ,0 explicitly if you do not want the time changed
查最後一條 TCP/IP AT 指令的錯誤碼與文字說明，只對最後一條有效: Query the error code and text description of the last TCP/IP AT command; only the last one is available
執行式，列出所有現存 socket 的類型、位址、埠、狀態與存取模式: Execution command that lists the type, address, port, state and access mode of every existing socket
開 TCP client：context 1、connectID 0、緩衝模式、: Open a TCP client: context 1, connectID 0, buffer mode, local port automatic
以十六進位字串向 connectID 0 送出 5 位元組，字串上限 512 b: Send 5 bytes to connectID 0 as a hex string; the string is limited to 512 bytes
長度填 0 是查詢：回傳已送、已 ACK、未 ACK 位元組數，不送資料: A length of 0 makes it a query: it returns the sent, ACKed and un-ACKed byte counts without sending data
從 connectID 0 緩衝最多讀 1500 位元組，無資料時回 +QIRD: Read up to 1500 bytes from connectID 0's buffer; with no data it returns +QIRD: 0
緩衝已空 —— 讀到 0 之後模組才會再發下一次 +QIURC: \"recv\: Buffer empty — only after a read returns 0 will the module issue the next +QIURC: "recv" notification
查 connectID 0 累計收到、已讀、未讀的長度，不會取出資料: Query connectID 0's total received, read and unread lengths without consuming the data
關閉 connectID 0 這條 socket，預設最長 10 秒回應且期間阻: Close the connectID 0 socket; by default it answers within 10 s and blocks meanwhile
2＝verbose，錯誤改吐文字敘述如 SIM not inserted，最好判: 2 = verbose: errors come out as text such as SIM not inserted, which is the easiest to read.
1＝numeric，錯誤改吐數字碼如 +CME ERROR: 10，也是出廠值。: 1 = numeric: errors come out as numeric codes such as +CME ERROR: 10; this is also the factory value.
